brief:
Israel's ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, said he hopes for a return to "traditional friendship" between the countries on the third anniversary of October 7, according to The Guardian. Relations between Israel and Australia have deteriorated since 2023 over multiple issues, Newman acknowledged.

The ambassador suggested a "reset" remains possible despite the strain. He did not elaborate on which specific disputes have driven the rift or what conditions such a reset would require.
